newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares in Gajoen Kanko ask-only on TSE.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Gajoen Kanko ask-only on TSE.

text.p: Shares of hotel operator Gajoen Kanko KK were ask-only at 99 yen on Monday on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in reaction to the company's announcement last Friday that it had suspended its new share allotment plan, brokers said.
The company said last week that it decided to suspend its plan to allocate new shares to its existing shareholders because it was to unable to find a bank to do the financial settlements.
The hotel operator said on November 29 that it would issue 28.29 million shares to be allocated to existing shareholders.
The new share issue was to raise funds to finance new projects and renovations of existing hotels, the company said.
